highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named script constants. Later previews improve reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, clip recording and displacement precision while retaining SkiaSharp's managed API surface.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without adding C bridge exports or changing SkiaSharp managed signatures. The initial HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300 revision still bundles HarfBuzz 14.4.0; Preview 2 upgrades that engine to 15.0.0.

HarfBuzzSharp adds Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, Seal and 27 previously omitted Script constants. The existing 149 values, struct-based API, parsing, numeric conversions and direction lookup remain intact. The unused deprecated native font-face setter import is removed without removing a public member.

Corrects reflected zero-length hairline cap sizing and text-atlas sampler selection. Graphite counts undrawn clips when deciding to flush and logs and skips draws whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass, rather than overflowing pass capacity.

Adds a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 through below 56. Native synchronous submission incorporates fence-wait failure; GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offsets use float precision to match filter bounds, with asynchronous submission unchanged.

The shared HashCode polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process; first use now initializes the cryptography dependency.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash-code seed with OS-generated randomness and added analyzer enforcement for shipped code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17: Improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan fence-wait handling, without adding a managed Submit result. The shared hash-code polyfill now uses OS-generated randomness while preserving within-process stability.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Upgrades to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds 30 Script constants. GPU fixes correct reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Introduces Skia m158 without changing the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp upgrades the bundled engine to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing script values and the struct-based programming model remain compatible.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.

v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.headline: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling.
v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.body: The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated randomness while remaining stable within a process. Managed API signatures are unchanged.
